title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON COMPENSATION, ETC. FOLLOWING ABOLITION OF CORRECTIONAL INSTITUTION GUARD UNITS
title_original: 경비교도대 폐지에 따른 보상 등에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Compensation, etc. Following Abolition of Correctional Institution Guard Units and matters necessary for its enforcement. Article 2 (Death Benefits) (1) Where a correctional guard dies while performing duties (including a subsequent death resulting from an injury), the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs shall pay death benefits to the bereaved family under Article 3 of the Act on Compensation, etc. Following Abolition of Correctional Institution Guard Units (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). Article 39 (2) of the Military Accident Compensation Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the amount of death benefits. (2) Articles 5 and 13 of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of and Support for Persons of Distinguished Service to the State shall apply mutatis mutandis to the scope and priority of bereaved family members eligible for death benefits under paragraph (1). Article 3 (Disability Benefits) Where a correctional guard who retired due to an injury sustained in the performance of duties is assigned a disability rating under Article 6-4 of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of and Support for Persons of Distinguished Service to the State or Article 6 of the Act on Support for Persons Eligible for Veteran's Compensation, the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs shall pay disability benefits according to the following classifications pursuant to Article 3 of the Act. 1. Person with a disability rating of Grade 1: the amount calculated according to the following original formula: (Average standard monthly income of all public officials × ) × 2. Person with a disability rating of Grade 2 through Grade 5: the amount calculated according to the following original formula: (Average standard monthly income of all public officials × ) × 3. Person with a disability rating of Grade 6 or Grade 7: the amount calculated according to the following original formula: (Average standard monthly income of all public officials × ) × Article 4 (Death Benefits after Payment of Disability Benefits) When a person who has received disability benefits under Article 3 dies as a result of the same injury, death benefits shall be paid in the amount remaining after deducting the disability benefits already paid from the death benefits under Article 2. Article 5 (Notification of Persons Eligible for Benefits) Where a person becomes eligible for death benefits under Article 2 or disability benefits under Article 3 (hereinafter referred to as "benefits"), the Minister of Justice shall notify the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs without delay. Article 6 (Claims for Benefits) (1) Benefits shall be claimed from the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs within five years from the date of death or the date of retirement due to injury. (2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), where the Minister of Justice recognizes that a correctional guard died while performing duties, death benefits may be claimed within five years from the date of such recognition. (3) If benefits could not be claimed within the period provided in paragraph (1) or (2) due to war, a national emergency, or any other unavoidable cause, the period for claiming benefits shall be extended by two years. (4) Matters necessary for the procedure for claiming and paying benefits shall be determined by the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs. Article 7 (Persons Eligible for Compensation) (1) Persons eligible for compensation under Article 4 of the Act shall be classified as follows: 1. A person who retired after sustaining an injury in the performance of duties or during education and training directly related to national defense and security or the protection of the lives and property of the people, and who has received a disability rating under Article 6-4 of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of and Support for Persons of Distinguished Service to the State: a soldier or police officer wounded in the line of duty under Article 4 (1) 6 of that Act; 2. A person who retired after sustaining an injury in the performance of duties or during education and training not directly related to national defense and security or the protection of the lives and property of the people, and who has received a disability rating under Article 6 of the Act on Support for Persons Eligible for Veteran's Compensation: a soldier or police officer injured as a result of a disaster under Article 2 (1) 2 of that Act; 3. The bereaved family of a person who died in the performance of duties or during education and training directly related to national defense and security or the protection of the lives and property of the people (including a later death resulting from injury): the bereaved family of a soldier or police officer killed in the line of duty under Article 4 (1) 5 of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of and Support for Persons of Distinguished Service to the State; 4. The bereaved family of a person who died in the performance of duties or during education and training not directly related to national defense and security or the protection of the lives and property of the people (including a later death resulting from injury): the bereaved family of a soldier or police officer who died from a disaster under Article 2 (1) 1 of the Act on Support for Persons Eligible for Veteran's Compensation. (2) A person intending to receive compensation under Article 4 of the Act shall apply for registration under Article 6 of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of and Support for Persons of Distinguished Service to the State or Article 4 of the Act on Support for Persons Eligible for Veteran's Compensation. (3) Upon receipt of an application for registration under paragraph (2), the head of the Patriots and Veterans Affairs agency shall request the Minister of Justice to verify facts relating to the eligibility requirements; the Minister of Justice shall verify the facts and notify the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs without delay. Article 8 (Handling of Sensitive Information) The Minister of Justice may process information concerning health under Article 23 of the Personal Information Protection Act, if unavoidable for conducting the following affairs: 1. Affairs concerning the payment of benefits under Article 3 of the Act; 2. Affairs concerning compensation under Article 4 of the Act. ADDENDA <27617,20161129> ADDENDA Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on November 30, 2016. Article 2 (Repeal of Other Decrees) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment of Correctional Institution Guard Units is hereby repealed. Article 3 (Applicability to Payment of Death and Disability Benefits) Articles 2 and 3 shall apply starting with applications for benefits filed after this Decree takes effect. Article 4 (Transitional Measures for Payment of Death Benefits Where Disability Benefits Have Been Paid) With respect to persons who received disability benefits before this Decree took effect, the former Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment of Correctional Institution Guard Units shall apply, notwithstanding Article 4. Article 5 (Amendments to Other Decrees) (1) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of Persons of Distinguished Service to the May 18 Democratization Movement shall be amended as follows: In Article 50 (1) 2, "members of the auxiliary police and correctional institution guards" shall be replaced with "members of the auxiliary police". (2) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Support for Patients Suffering from Actual or Potential Aftereffects of Defoliants and Establishment of Related Organizations shall be amended as follows: In Article 10-2 (1) 2 (c), "correctional institution guards and auxiliary police transferred to alternative service pursuant to Articles 24 and 25 of the Military Service Act" shall be replaced with "auxiliary police transferred to alternative service pursuant to Article 25 of the Military Service Act". (3) The Regulations on Remuneration of Public Officials shall be amended as follows: In Article 1, "the Act on the Establishment of Correctional Institution Guard Units and the Act on the Establishment of Obligatory Fire Service Units" shall be replaced with "the Act on the Establishment of Obligatory Fire Service Units". (4) The Regulations on Allowances for Public Officials, etc. shall be amended as follows: In Articles 7 and 12, "correctional institution guards and students at the National Police University" shall in each instance be replaced with "students at the National Police University". (5) The Regulations on Travel Expenses of Public Officials shall be amended as follows: In Article 27, "auxiliary police and correctional institution guards" shall be replaced with "auxiliary police". (6) The Enforcement Decree of the National Sports Promotion Act shall be amended as follows: In Article 15-3 (5) 3, "correctional institution guards and auxiliary police transferred to alternative service pursuant to Articles 24 and 25 of the Military Service Act" shall be replaced with "auxiliary police transferred to alternative service pursuant to Article 25 of the Military Service Act". (7) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Collection and Use of Donations shall be amended as follows: Article 15 (1) 4 shall be deleted. (8) The Enforcement Decree of the Tobacco Business Act shall be amended as follows: In Article 7 (1) 2, "members of the auxiliary police and members of correctional institution guard units" shall be replaced with "members of the auxiliary police". (9) The Enforcement Decree of the Road Traffic Act shall be amended as follows: In Articles 55 (1) 5 and 57 (1) 5, "correctional institution guards and auxiliary police" shall in each instance be replaced with "auxiliary police". (10) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Private Correctional Institutions, etc. shall be amended as follows: In Article 18 (2), "correctional officers (including correctional institution guards)" shall be replaced with "correctional officers". (11) The Enforcement Decree of the Military Service Act shall be amended as follows: In Article 2 (1) 2, "correctional institution guards and obligatory firefighters" shall be replaced with "obligatory firefighters", and "the Minister of Justice and the Minister of Public Safety and Security" shall be replaced with "the Minister of Public Safety and Security". In Article 41 (1), "the Minister of Justice and the Minister of Public Safety and Security" shall be replaced with "the Minister of Public Safety and Security", and "correctional institution guards and obligatory firefighters under Articles 24 and 25 of the Act" shall be replaced with "obligatory firefighters under Article 25 of the Act". Article 42 shall be deleted. In Article 44, "the Minister of Justice and the Minister of Public Safety and Security" shall be replaced with "the Minister of Public Safety and Security". In Article 45 (1), "the Minister of Justice and the Minister of Public Safety and Security" shall be replaced with "the Minister of Public Safety and Security", and "correctional institution guards and obligatory firefighters" shall be replaced with "obligatory firefighters". In Article 46 (1), "the Minister of Justice and the Minister of Public Safety and Security" shall be replaced with "the Minister of Public Safety and Security", and "correctional institution guards and obligatory firefighters" shall be replaced with "obligatory firefighters"; in paragraph (2), "the Minister of Justice and the Minister of Public Safety and Security" shall be replaced with "the Minister of Public Safety and Security"; in paragraph (3), "the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment of Correctional Institution Guard Units and the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment of Obligatory Fire Service Units" shall be replaced with "the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment of Obligatory Fire Service Units". In Article 130 (4) 3, "correctional institution guards and obligatory firefighters under Article 24 or 25 of the Act" shall be replaced with "obligatory firefighters under Article 25 of the Act". In Article 169 (4), "correctional institution guards and obligatory firefighters under Articles 24 and 25 of the Act" shall be replaced with "obligatory firefighters under Article 25 of the Act", and "the Minister of Justice and the Minister of Public Safety and Security" shall be replaced with "the Minister of Public Safety and Security". (12) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Anti-Corruption and the Establishment and Operation of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission shall be amended as follows: In Article 35 (2) 6, "correctional institution guards and auxiliary police" shall be replaced with "auxiliary police". (13) The Enforcement Decree of the Income Tax Act shall be amended as follows: In Article 10, "auxiliary police and correctional institution guards" shall be replaced with "auxiliary police". (14) The Enforcement Decree of the Water-Related Leisure Activities Safety Act shall be amended as follows: In Article 7-4 (1) 4, "correctional institution guards and auxiliary police" shall be replaced with "auxiliary police". (15) The Enforcement Decree of the Restriction of Special Taxation Act shall be amended as follows: In Article 27 (1) 1 (a), "Articles 24 and 25" shall be replaced with "Article 25", and "correctional institution guards and auxiliary police" shall be replaced with "auxiliary police". (16) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of War Veterans and the Establishment of Related Organizations shall be amended as follows: In Article 10, subparagraph 2, "members of the auxiliary police and correctional institution guards" shall be replaced with "members of the auxiliary police". (17) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of Persons of Distinguished Service in Special Missions and the Establishment of Related Organizations shall be amended as follows: In Article 55, subparagraph 2, "members of the auxiliary police and correctional institution guards" shall be replaced with "members of the auxiliary police".
